beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then follow the history of technology as a history of changing political possibilities.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The fuller proposal asks how communities could shape places without acquiring permanent guardians.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its interest lies in making ecological limits and institutional independence part of the same design.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to judge what a beautiful future must allow its inhabitants to control.
